title: Boxes panel: a new box's name field gets stuck open when left unchanged (fix in 2.1.4)
description: Fabio 2026-10-27, found in 2.1.3 testing; ships as is in 2.1.3 (release in progress), fix lands in 2.1.4. Repro: open Boxes, draw a box, click away without typing. The box's NAME stays an open text field for good (screenshot: 'box2' framed in yellow); typing there renames the box instead of describing it, so Fabio got 'boxbox_33' while trying to write what goes in the box. Root cause (read, not run): MpiBoxesPanel.js _rename() swaps the name button for an MpiInput and only puts it back from that input's 'change' handler (via _changed -> _renderList). MpiInput type text emits 'change' from the native change event (MpiInput.js:157), which does NOT fire on blur when the value is unchanged, so leaving the field untouched never closes it. Also the auto-opened name field sits right beside the 'What goes here' field and reads as the box asking for its description. Fix: _rename closes on blur and Escape whatever the value (re-render the row), keeps Enter; then decide with Fabio whether a new box should open its name at all or focus 'What goes here' instead (look-and-feel call). Verify: draw a box, click away -> name is a button again; draw, type a name, Enter -> renamed; spec in the boxes panel tests.
